answer: Quadratic staking lockup requires each validator to post collateral C with slashing penalty lambda*C^2, so the marginal cost of a Sybil node grows super-linearly with cluster size. A ZK-VDF time-lock binds stake release, forcing any attacker to front-load capital at the nadir of expected reward while the consensus threshold T guarantees total locked value exceeds extractable gain. The resulting Nash equilibrium isolates a malicious island in an economic orchard where any deviation yields negative expected utility.
